description: An oil-painting style scene in a dim, wood-paneled laboratory with shelves of books and glassware. A bearded man in a dark suit and pince-nez leans over a seated young man in a grey waistcoat, both looking at a brass apparatus with two white clock-like dials and wires running to a battery box. The setting suggests the late 19th century. No legible text, no visible frame, and nothing gory.
